name: Avif
description: Generates Avif copies of image style derivatives.

suggests.drupal/imagemagick: ^4.0.2 (require-dev; the shipped 'imagemagick' processor needs a toolkit that can encode AVIF)

project_description:
Creates an AVIF copy of image style derivatives to decrease loading times.

 
 Contribution 
 - To submit bug reports and feature suggestions, or to track changes:

 https://www.drupal.org/project/issues/avif 

 Dependency 
 
 Need an image manipulation toolkit which supports AVIF. 
 
 Installation 
 
 Classic installation as other modules. 
 Install responsive_image module (Drupal 8 core) 
 Select Responsive image in admin/config/media/responsive-image-style for the style you want to use 
 Go to your content type, display, and choose responsive image (ie: admin/structure/types/manage/article/display) 
 Optional clear caches 
 
 Configuration 
 Admin >> config >> media >> Avif

- Choose your Avif Processor

- Set your image quality

 Avif Processors 
 - Image Magick included in this module,

- GD in progress ,

- CAVIF RS .
